## Problem

What user or maintainer problem does this solve?

## Change

Describe the focused solution and any compatibility considerations.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `mypy`
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `code-health scan . --no-cache --fail-on high`
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` updated when user-visible

## Additional context

Link the related issue and include safe sample output when useful. Do not include credentials,
proprietary source, or undisclosed vulnerability details.
